results.title: Chill Systems Beverage Cooler Shark Tank Season 12
results.content:
Chase Mitchell and Brian Bloch never missed an episode of Shark Tank. The college friends were aspiring entrepreneurs and bounced around countless startup ideas while cheering on the lucky people who appeared on the show. But their “eureka” moment happened at a bluegrass festival in San Francisco’s Golden Gate Park. The park was muddy from recent downpours, and people carrying or dragging heavy coolers struggled through the muck. There had to be a better way! And Chase and Brian found it: the first compact, portable chiller that doesn’t use ice or gel packs to cool your drinks. Chill Systems saves time by eliminating those last-minute trips to get ice; saves the money spent on ice; saves the space taken up by a bulky cooler; and saves the environment by reducing the need for single-use [...] ### The Chiller

The Chiller is a lightweight, durable beverage cooler made from recycled materials with freezing gel inside its walls and an insulating exterior wrap that creates an icy chamber for your beverages: beer, wine, spirits, soda, coffee, sports drinks, kombucha, etc. Simply freeze the chiller overnight, load it up with your beverages, and off you go to the beach, pool, barbecue, sports arena, road trip, boat or maybe just as far as your sofa when you want to binge on Game of Thrones. [...] The Chiller is comparable to the size of a football. It will chill three 12-16 ounce cans or bottles at a time or one 750-ml wine bottle in the larger side opening. The temperature of the beverage will drop up to 20 degrees in the first hour, and the Chiller will keep chilling drinks for up to six hours. So during those six hours, you can chill round after round of beverages, for example, a 24-pack of beer or 6 bottles of wine.

### Chill Systems Adventure Pack and Picnic Tote

The Chiller stays cold up to 24 hours when used with the insulated Adventure Pack or Picnic Tote, your portable beverage cooling systems.

Keeping beverages cool during picnics and other outdoor excursions is an age-old conundrum — one that entrepreneurs Brian Bloch and Chase Mitchell hoped to solve with their company, Chill Systems. While a Kickstarter campaign initiated in 2021 raised $53,172 to help Chill Systems fulfill orders with its manufacturer, Bloch and Mitchell endeavored to seek out greater financial assistance for their emerging product. However, unlike similar "Shark Tank" companies such as Kanga, the company hasn't stood the test of time. [...] Bloch and Mitchell headed to "Shark Tank" and its pantheon of entrepreneurs, an experience that didn't pan out as the team expected. Most notably, Shark Kevin O'Leary exclaimed, "It only holds three cans?" when faced with Chill Systems' proprietary cooling device, which was christened "the chiller."

Bloch and Mitchell developed the chiller over the course of two years, and their work resulted in a portable cooler capable of holding three cans or one bottle of wine at a time. The device used an internal freezing gel to cool beverages, which retained its chilly temperatures from four to six hours. While seemingly innovative, the chiller and its creators had some problems, which ultimately created a roadblock on their path to success.
